question: Which of the following molecules has triangular plane geometry?
analysis: BF3 (Boron trifluoride) has a triangular planar geometry due to its trigonal planar arrangement of electron pairs around the boron atom, which is consistent with VSEPR theory. The other options do not exhibit this geometry: NH3 (Ammonia) has a trigonal pyramidal shape, AsH3 (Arsenic trihydride) also has a trigonal pyramidal shape, XeO3 (Xenon trioxide) has a pyramidal shape, and ClF3 (Chlorine trifluoride) has a T-shaped geometry.
